name: Rio Puerco Woodworks
old_description: Rio Puerco Woodworks specializes in custom hand-crafted doors for homes and businesses in Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, Santa Fe, and surrounding areas. Our craftsman Jack Haring creates one-of-a-kind interior and exterior wooden doors. He can bring to life your design or help you create the centerpiece door you’ve been looking for.
about:
Rio Puerco Woodworks is based in Rio Rancho, New Mexico. The workshop was established in the late 1990s by Jack Haring, a craftsman who traces his roots to a family of Texas engineers and honed his skills at a prominent woodworking shop in New York City before moving to New Mexico. The business remains owner-operated by Haring.

The company produces custom hand-crafted interior and exterior doors for residential and commercial clients across the Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, and Santa Fe areas. Each door is built to order, with Haring working directly with customers to develop designs that range from traditional panel doors to complex arched entries for circular rooms. The shop also offers custom furniture pieces, though doors remain the core focus.

Rio Puerco serves homeowners, builders, and commercial contractors who need one-of-a-kind architectural woodwork. Past projects have included distinctive challenges such as an arched front door for a circular entry room, and the company’s work has been featured in regional newspapers and magazines. Clients typically engage through design consultations at the Rio Rancho workshop.

Haring emphasizes a collaborative approach, guiding clients from concept through fabrication to create personalized centerpiece doors. The business was founded on his desire to apply engineering-minded precision to artistic woodworking, a philosophy that continues to drive each project.
